description: This file defines a GUI component for a media player within the BORIS software, including classes for clickable labels and a dockable player widget with volume control, mute functionality, and signal handling.

classes.name: Clickable_label
classes.description: A QLabel subclass that emits a signal when clicked, used for visualizing frames for geometric measurements.

classes.name: DW_player
classes.description: A QDockWidget subclass that provides a media player interface with volume control, mute, and frame viewing capabilities.

methods.name: mousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events on the label, emitting a signal with the label ID and event.

methods.name: mpv_logger
methods.description: Redirects MPV log messages to the general logging system.

methods.name: volume_slider_moved
methods.description: Emits a signal when the volume slider is moved.

methods.name: mute_action_triggered
methods.description: Handles mute button actions, toggling icon and emitting a signal.

methods.name: keyPressEvent
methods.description: Emits a signal when a key is pressed on the dock widget.

methods.name: resizeEvent
methods.description: Emits a signal when the dock widget is resized.
